title: NewPage - Technical Principal - AI Solutions
description:
**Job Description :**
Tech Principal, AI Solutions. Location : Hybrid | Type : Full-time.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices. We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping : when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement, a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence : you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering. Third, delivery governance : you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably.
  
  
You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built : not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape Solutions in Discovery :
* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the client's problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end : target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually : layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership : team shape, phasing, milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.
* Set the Engineering Standards :
* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build : reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.
* Govern and Steer Delivery :
* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects : regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly : get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background : you have shaped engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products : RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models : you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for : QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams : technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication : you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft : you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer :
  
  

* A people-first culture : supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

title: Product Implementation Lead -AI/ML
description:
**About Superteams**

Superteams builds AI-powered products and solutions that help businesses solve real-world problems through intelligent automation.

We work with businesses to build, integrate, and deploy cutting-edge AI applications, helping them turn emerging technologies into practical business solutions.

We are looking for an
**AI/ML Product Implementation Lead**

who can manage a small technical team, drive product implementations, and work closely with our engineering and customer teams to deliver reliable solutions.

This is an opportunity to work in an
**agile startup environment alongside cutting-edge AI/ML technologies**

, contribute to real-world projects, and take ownership of solutions from development to deployment.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and coordinate a team of engineers working on product development and implementation.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable technical tasks.
* Plan implementation activities, allocate work, track progress, and ensure timely delivery.
* Work closely with developers to build, integrate, test, and deploy software solutions.

* Stay updated on emerging technologies and help the team explore new tools and approaches.

**What We're Looking For**
**Experience & Technical Skills**

* 4+ years of experience in software development, product implementation, technical consulting, or a related engineering role.
* Strong programming fundamentals, preferably with hands-on experience in Python.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, and software integrations.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, and application deployment.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI applications is an advantage, but extensive specialised experience is not required.
* Experience taking software projects from development or POC to deployment is preferred.

**Team Leadership & Project Management**

* Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of developers or engineers.
* Ability to break down requirements into tasks, assign responsibilities, and track execution.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to identify blockers, solve problems, and keep projects moving.
* Comfortable working directly with customers and communicating technical requirements.
* A proactive approach to ownership, accountability, and team collaboration.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LLM-based applications, RAG, AI agents, or other Generative AI solutions.
* Familiarity with vector databases and AI application frameworks.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI deployments or GPU infrastructure.
* Experience with vLLM, SGLang, or private and sovereign AI deployments.
* Experience working in a product company, startup, or client-facing engineering environment.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Search Platform
description:
****Overview****
****Working at Atlassian****
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Your future team: Search Platform**
The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search , knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100+ sources. Your deep expertise in large-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.
  
  
As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world-class end-to-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.
* Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.
* Make hard architectural trade-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity - and own the outcomes.
* Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.
* Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real-world data - schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.
* Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.
* Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data-driven engineering across Search Data teams.
* Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.

****Qualifications****
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
****Requirements:****

* Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) - you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Ideally for Search and AI use cases where innovation relies on iterating over data. You understand their failure modes, not just their happy paths.
* Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale - including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.
* Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.
* Demonstrated department-level technical leadership, influence across multiple teams, and ownership of top-level technical objectives tied to business outcomes. You identify ambiguity and bring clarity.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.
* Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data architecture to engineers, product managers, and leadership with equal clarity.
* 12+ years of experience imagining, building and operating critical systems at scale.

****Benefits & Perks****
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
****About Atlassian****
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Digital - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with 4-8 years of overall experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on expertise in Python, Generative AI and Agentic AI, backed by a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Transformer architectures. This is a hands-on role where you will be expected to operate as a strong individual contributor while also being able to work at a lead capacity, engaging directly stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own features end-to-end, from problem framing and model development to API design, deployment, and scaling on the cloud.
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Design and develop REST/APIs and integrate AI models into services.
* Scale applications and optimize performance for high-volume workloads.
* Deploy and operate models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
* Operate as a strong individual contributor and lead at a stakeholder engagement capacity.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4-8 years of overall hands-on experience in software/AI engineering (not limited to Generative AI).
* Proven track record of delivering production-grade AI/ML solutions.
* Very strong proficiency in Python and its AI/ML ecosystem.
* Solid hands-on experience with Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning).
* Strong foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts and techniques.
* Good working knowledge of NLP and Transformer-based architectures.
* Production-grade experience designing and developing REST/APIs and integrating AI models into services.
* Demonstrated experience in scaling applications and optimizing performance for high-volume workloads.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* Experience in deploying and operating models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Hands-on experience building Agentic AI systems (multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, autonomous workflows).
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.
* Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
* Exposure to Azure AI/OpenAI services, Azure ML, and serverless deployments.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Architect)**
**Experience:**
10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform architect expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption

* Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

* MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek - so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
  
  
**OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.
  
  
This role is ideal for candidates who combine hands-on laboratory experience with technical software implementation skills. Successful candidates typically have experience working in laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, LES, or laboratory automation environments.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. In addition, applying communication skills, creativity, and a can-do approach is vital.
  
  
**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Analyze customers' needs and translate them into OpenLab Sync workflows
* Configure the OpenLab Sync platform to match the lab's requirements
* Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals
* Act as the customer voice to influence future product design to meet customer needs
* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has a keen interest in Lab Informatics and is seeking a new challenge. A curious individual who is driven to learn and has the desire to understand and solve customer problems to deliver customer success will succeed in this position.
  
  
**Qualifications**
We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.
  
  
We will make sure
**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

description:

**Senior AI Architect**

* 15+ years overall; 8+ years in Java/J2EE; 2+ years in AI/GenAI delivery

**Role focus**

* AI-led modernization of enterprise Java platforms and creation of scalable, secure AI solutions

**The opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior AI Architect who combines deep Java/J2EE architecture expertise with hands-on AI and Generative AI delivery experience. The role will shape AI-first enterprise solutions, embed intelligent capabilities into existing Java estates, and guide clients from experimentation through secure, production-scale adoption.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product engineering, cloud-native modernization and applied AI. They will define target architectures, make technology decisions, lead engineering teams, and advise senior stakeholders on how AI can create measurable business and engineering outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI and solution architecture**

* Define end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled enterprise applications, from data ingestion and retrieval through model orchestration, inference, APIs, user experience and production operations.
* Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge graph, multimodal and agentic AI solutions aligned to business workflows.
* Design multi-agent systems / skills, tool-use patterns and orchestration approaches, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) where relevant.
* Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost.

**Java/J2EE engineering and modernization**

* Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs.
* Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns.
* Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity.
* Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management.
* Guide engineering teams on code quality, design patterns, performance, resilience, observability, security and maintainability.

**Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering**

* Design and deploy AI solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP using appropriate managed AI services and cloud-native components.
* Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback.
* Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost.
* Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback.
* Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment.

**Governance, security and responsible AI**

* Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design.
* Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk.
* Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads.

**Consulting, leadership and capability building**

* Lead discovery workshops, architecture assessments and design sessions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business goals into AI roadmaps, solution options, implementation plans and clear value cases.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership and communicate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks and outcomes in executive-ready language.
* Provide technical leadership for pursuits, proposals, solutioning and estimation, including architecture narratives and delivery models.
* Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of architects, Java engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and platform specialists.
* Create reusable accelerators, reference implementations, knowledge assets and engineering standards for the EAT competency.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Education: BE/BTech/MCA or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline.
* Overall experience: 15+ years in software architecture, engineering and enterprise solution delivery.
* Java/J2EE depth: 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, with strong Spring ecosystem experience.
* Architecture depth: 5+ years in microservices, distributed systems, API-led and event-driven architecture.
* AI delivery: 2+ years of hands-on architecture and implementation experience in AI/ML/GenAI initiatives, with evidence of production or enterprise-scale delivery.
* Leadership: Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and owning architecture and delivery outcomes.
* Consulting: Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, presales, storytelling and senior stakeholder communication skills.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
**Capability & Expected proficiency**

* Enterprise engineering - Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
* Integration and platforms - API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability
* GenAI and agentic AI - LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, semantic and hybrid search, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering
* AI frameworks - Hands-on exposure to relevant frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or Haystack
* Data and retrieval - SQL/NoSQL, vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or equivalent; knowledge graphs such as Neo4j
* Cloud AI - At least one of Azure OpenAI / Azure AI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI, with working awareness of the other major clouds
* Operationalization - CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support
* Security and governance - Identity and access, OAuth/OIDC or SAML, data protection, AI safety, Responsible AI, model risk and secure AI service integration

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Python and AI service development using FastAPI or Flask, alongside the primary Java/J2EE engineering background.
* Fine-tuning concepts, model optimization, quantization, open-source models and multimodal AI.
* GraphRAG, Knowledge-Augmented Generation, enterprise knowledge platforms and advanced retrieval/evaluation patterns.
* Workflow orchestration or BPM platforms such as Camunda, Airflow or Prefect.
* Infrastructure as Code and platform engineering using tools such as Terraform and GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Experience across regulated industries and familiarity with enterprise privacy, security and compliance expectations.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Java or AI certifications; contributions to internal accelerators, open-source projects or technical communities.

You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

description:

Aid customers in overcoming technical challenges during initial blueprinting and use case deployment.

Craft and deliver tailored demos that go beyond the standard, showcasing the unique value proposition Confluent has to offer.

* Knowledge Sharing, Workshops, and Training: Support cross-functional teams, including Field Marketing, Partner Solutions by conducting training sessions and workshops/webinars for customers, partners, prospects, and internal teams to educate them on Confluent's platform/cloud, features, and best practices.
* RFP/Vendor risk assessment Support: Contribute to vendor risk assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of potential risks and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Assist in answering Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs).
* Technical Artifact Creation and Maintenance: Architect, build, and maintain reusable artifacts, including tools, prototypes, demos, workshops, and architecture blueprints.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree

* Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre-sales capacity.
* Process & Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.
  
  

* First-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment & Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering & Integration).
* Clear, consistent demonstration of self-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must
* Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities to all levels across an organization.
* Ability to explain complex concepts in plain, non-technical language that resonates with mid-level managers and business owners.
* Fluency in English is a requisite.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Previous experience building solutions with Apache Kafka.
* Understanding of systems operations concepts (disk, network, operating systems, etc).
* Experience with software development tools, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus
* Experience building and operating large scale systems.
* Experience in technical pre-sales or consultative roles.

title: Principal Engineer, Search Platform
description:
****Overview****
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
As a Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will serve as a technical leader driving the core indexing engines and enterprise-grade trust capabilities that power Atlassian Search and Rovo.
  
  
You will lead the technical vision, architecture and delivery for planetary-scale data ingestion and indexing platforms while ensuring Search meets strict enterprise commitments across multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), isolated cloud, compliance, and encryption.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead Enterprise Trust & Compliance: Own technical strategy and delivery for enterprise requirements - multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), Isolated Cloud, FedRAMP, BYOK encryption, and data residency - making Search a platform enterprises can trust. Proactively simplifying architecture and removing
* Shape the Indexing Platform for AI-era Workloads: Evolve high-throughput, low-latency distributed indexing pipelines to meet the retrieval demands of agentic and AI use cases - freshness, context relevance, and scale across billions of events.
* Connect Across Teams and Systems: Work fluidly across ML, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, and product teams - aligning technical direction, unblocking dependencies, and building shared platform capabilities that multiply the impact of teams beyond your own. Help improve support for building and operating systems that deliver true Enterprise Trust through Atlassian-wide platforms, while actively simplifying the architecture and eliminating accumulated complexity.
* Drive System Efficiency at Scale: Improve ingestion throughput, data freshness, and reliability while optimizing for unit economics through smarter sharding, disaggregated storage, and compute efficiency.
* Capitalize on Agentic Development Advances: Stay ahead of the curve on retrieval architectures, vector/hybrid indexing, and agentic memory patterns - bringing external advances in to accelerate Atlassian's platform and product roadmap.

****Qualifications****
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
****Requirements****

* Enterprise Platform Experience: 12+ years of demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade requirements - tenant isolation, multi-cloud deployments, compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, BYOK, data residency), and zero-downtime migrations at scale.
* Distributed Systems Depth: Proven experience designing and operating large-scale distributed data pipelines, search/indexing systems, or streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Flink, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, object-store-backed indexing, vector search).
* Cross-functional Influence: Experience driving alignment and delivery across multiple teams and systems - someone who is just as effective collaborating and influencing as they are executing independently.
* Speed with Judgment: A track record of making fast, pragmatic trade-offs that deliver near-term value without accumulating long-term technical debt.
* Agentic & AI-Aware Engineering: Familiarity with systems that support AI agents and pragmatic approaches to integrate safe agentic engineering practices for building robust Enterprise grade systems.

****Benefits & Perks****
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
****About Atlassian****
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
**owning, governing, and continuously improving the technical integration landscape**
supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides
**hands-on Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) expertise**
from day one, translating integration requirements into reliable, supportable, and scalable data flows across o9 and upstream or downstream enterprise systems.
  
  
This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

**Candidate Evidence Expected**
Candidates should be prepared to provide concrete examples from recent o9 engagements, including:
  
  

* Their exact role, duration, and ownership in each o9 project.
* INT3.0 interfaces designed or delivered, source and target systems, data volumes or cadence, and production responsibilities.
* Examples of complex incidents diagnosed and permanently resolved.
* Examples of integration design documents, runbooks, monitoring approaches, or error-management practices they created.
* Python solutions personally developed and the business or operational problem addressed.
* Current o9 certifications and evidence of relevant o9 training completion.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.
  
  
What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.
  
  
Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Agents whose output nobody re-checks.**
You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.
  
  
**A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know.**
Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.
  
  
Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.
  
  
**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.
* An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.
* Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.
* 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.
* Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.
* Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.
* Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
